instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Precision Components Inc. is a medium-sized manufacturer specializing in high-tolerance industrial components for the medical device and aerospace sectors. The company operates under strict ISO certifications and must adhere to rigorous environmental and safety regulations. Their operations are labor-intensive but require increasingly precise quality control systems.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently implemented a Lean manufacturing overhaul aimed at reducing scrap rates by 15%. They also invested in pilot projects for automated inspection tools, though full integration remains challenging.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to achieve operational excellence and drastically reduce production costs while maintaining zero compliance violations. Secondary goals include expanding into high-margin specialized components.
answers.teamSize: The core innovation team consists of 5 senior engineers and two process specialists who operate with autonomy but require executive alignment on major capital expenditures.
answers.additionalContext: The market is highly competitive with smaller agile firms and large, heavily automated competitors. Regulatory compliance costs are currently a significant drain on operational efficiency.

opportunities.title: Full AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance and Process Optimization Platform
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory demands for uptime and efficiency, adopting a radical predictive maintenance system using ML can drastically reduce unplanned downtime and optimize resource allocation across the factory floor.

first_actions: Conduct a 3-month feasibility study on sensor integration in critical machinery.
Form an interdepartmental task force (Engineering, IT) to define data requirements.
resources_needed: Cloud computing subscription for ML model training
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce unscheduled downtime by 30% within 12 months.
milestones: Q1: Pilot integration on three critical production lines.
Q3: Full rollout across all key machinery.

opportunities.title: Modular, Automated Quality Check Line Implementation
opportunities.rationale: To improve efficiency and meet high regulatory standards, implementing smaller automated inspection modules rather than a monolithic overhaul will allow for phased integration with controlled testing environments.

first_actions: Select one specific production line for automation pilot project.
Audit current tooling to identify bottleneck quality control points.
resources_needed: Capital expenditure for robotic inspection equipment
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease defect rate by 10% in the pilot line.
milestones: Q2: Select vendor and finalize ROI calculation.
Q4: Complete implementation on selected production line.

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional steering committee to define efficiency KPIs and high-priority regulatory pain points.
Initiate the feasibility study for AI predictive maintenance, including budget approval request.
Review current supply chain processes against industry best practices to identify immediate incremental efficiencies.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent cross-departmental communication regarding innovation strategy
High reliance on manual quality checks leading to inefficiency and potential errors
Lack of a dedicated, specialized data science talent pool
Process rigidity hindering the rapid implementation of incremental improvements
